body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.38 (naive base rate 0.45) that: Cummins India Q3 FY27 standalone operating margin recovers to ≥17.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (16-Nov-2026): gross margin down ~400 bps on raw-material inflation and mix; management declined to say margins have bottomed ('refrained from giving a guidance on gross margins bottoming out'); data-centre gensets remain the growth driver, exports marginally down. Screener standalone: OPM Mar-25 21%, Jun-25 21%, Sep-25 22%, Dec-25 21%, Mar-26 21%, Jun-26 18%, Sep-26 15%; Sep-26 sales ₹3,301 cr (+4% YoY), operating profit ₹506 cr. Reasoning: Input-cost inflation is broad (Sona, HUL, Asian Paints all flag it) and price increases lag; a 2-pt rebound in one quarter needs pricing plus mix help. We lean toward a slow recovery. Resolution: YES if Q3 FY27 (Dec-2026) standalone Operating Profit ÷ Sales on screener.in (standalone view) ≥17.0%. Source: screener.in Cummins India standalone quarterly; company Q3 FY27 results. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Mean-reversion base: after a sharp 2-quarter margin fall, a quality industrial recovers ≥2 pts next quarter roughly 45% of the time.

title: Paper call: Cummins India Q3 FY27 standalone operating margin recovers to ≥17.0%
